reviews.comment:
I do apologise for not writing this review sooner.

I hadn't driven for 18 years (Since I passed my driving test) and decided to start again.  I contacted many driving instructors in the Maidenhead area and Nadeem was by far to friendliest and most accommodating.    Went out of his way to provide me with a refresher lesson at 7:30pm!

Having been nervous about driving again, Nadeem met me and we spoke about why I was nervous, he was very into psychology and he provided confidence and support and explained that I will not crash and I need to get into a car and believe I will not crash etc.  I then drove for an hour with Nadeem just chatting and observing and playing music.  He was an incredibly nice and humble person and after one refresher I was so happy and buzzing as he gave me the confidence boost I needed.

I have now moved completely out of the area and regularly drive on motorways and in towns regularly.

I highly recommend Nadeem, a great teacher and a fantastic bloke.

Thank you again!

Damien
